intro.text: 这条视频是写出来的，不是拖出来的。
intro.spoken: This video was written, not dragged together.

record.text: 录屏会跟着点击自动推近。
record.spoken: Screen recordings zoom in on every click.

record.text: 光标、点击涟漪，都是后期加上去的。
record.spoken: The cursor and click ripples are added afterwards.

photo.text: 一张图，加上慢推、暖色和漏光，就动起来了。
photo.spoken: A still gets a slow push, a warm look and a light leak.

clip.text: 视频片段加上黑边和胶片颗粒，马上有电影感。
clip.spoken: Letterbox and film grain make any clip feel cinematic.

numbers.text: 十种转场，十几个特效参数，十种叠加元素。
numbers.spoken: Ten transitions, a dozen effect controls, ten overlay types.

how.text: 你在界面里拖，AI 用命令行改，改的是同一份文件。
how.spoken: You drag in the UI, the AI edits through the CLI, both on the same file.

outro.spoken: It's open source. Give it a try.
